rules: Official organizer sources take precedence; secondary calendar entries remain provisional.
Do not promote 2026 route details or GPX files to 2027 without explicit organizer confirmation.
Third-party GPX previews are not official binary downloads or validated tracks.
Do not delete or overwrite old GPX files until a new official binary is downloaded, fully parsed and validated.
Audit-only: no live event records or app runtime changed.

events.name: Padova Half Marathon
events.detail: Organizer's official page confirms 18 April 2027, 21.097km, 09:45 start at Abano Terme and finish at Prato della Valle. Route narrative runs via Montegrotto and Padua centre; no GPX binary or numeric ascent validated.

events.name: Rimini Marathon
events.startFinish: Rotonda Lucio Battisti, Marina Centro, Rimini, Italy
events.detail: Official 2027 regulation confirms 12th edition, 42.195km, 18 April, 09:00 start, measured and FIDAL-homologated course. Organizer describes route as mostly flat and fast, passing Rimini historic centre, Riccione and Misano Adriatico. No GPX binary parsed.

events.name: Rimini Half Marathon
events.startFinish: Rotonda Lucio Battisti, Marina Centro, Rimini, Italy
events.detail: Organizer FAQ confirms half marathon 18 April 2027 at 08:30. Official course page displays course map for 18 April 2027 and describes a flat course. No GPX binary downloaded or parsed.

events.name: Trieste Spring Run 42K
events.detail: Organizer homepage announces return of the marathon in Trieste on Sunday 2 May 2027. The page has event details and route references from 2026; no 2027 route geometry, GPX or numeric ascent confirmed.

events.name: Trieste Spring Run 21K
events.detail: The organizer homepage's 21K description appears in the 2026 event context, while its 2027 save-the-date announcement explicitly highlights the return of the 42K. A separate 2027 half-marathon race is not confirmed in the checked organizer material. Keep this database event unconfirmed pending explicit 2027 announcement.

events.name: Lucca Half Marathon
events.detail: 2027 calendar entry lists 2 May and 21.0975km; organizer regulation, start time, route and GPX are not yet available in checked sources.

events.name: ColleMar-athon
events.location: Terre Roveresche to Fano, Marche, Italy
events.detail: 2027 calendar lists 9 May 2027; however official organizer programme currently shows 3 May 2026 and route details for Barchi–Mondavio–Orciano–San Giorgio–Piagge–Cerasa–San Costanzo–Fano, start 09:00 and finish Arco d'Augusto. Do not assign 2026 route to 2027. Third-party GPX preview exists but cannot establish official edition validity.

events.name: Half ColleMar-athon
events.detail: 2027 calendar listing gives 9 May and 21.0975km; rules and start time still undefined. Official organizer programme currently contains 2026 schedule, not 2027. Do not use historic route as current.

events.name: Placentia Half Marathon
events.detail: Official 30th edition regulation confirms 9 May 2027, 21.097km, start 09:30 from Via Cavour and finish in Piazza Cavalli. Some secondary event summary text says Piazza Cittadella, conflicting with official regulation; use official regulation. No GPX validated.

events.name: Bibione Half Marathon
events.detail: Official organizer page confirms 11th edition on 9 May 2027, 21.0975km, 09:00 start and FIDAL-certified course on paved roads and traffic-closed unpaved sections. No binary GPX or numeric elevation profile validated.

followUps: Padova Half, Rimini Marathon/Half, Placentia and Bibione: obtain official 2027 GPX binaries and validate full track geometry and ascent/descent.
Trieste: confirm whether 21K will also be staged in 2027; organizer currently confirms 42K return only.
Lucca: await organizer regulation and route; calendar-only listing remains provisional.
